integrity: Standalone exact exhaustive finite-state and Hasse graph checker included; proof of the top-cell homotopy splitting is mathematical, not inferred from homology. No independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Verified finite range 4 <= n <= 20 only; no all-n classification or proof of the full bidirected case. Primary paper had computational homology predictions for n <= 14; this result gives an integral homotopy strengthening. Bibliographic completeness is not guaranteed.
title: Integral homotopy classification through twenty vertices for one-arc-punctured bidirected cycles
